### Checks

- [ ] I ran `npm run submit:prepare -- ... --apply`.
- [ ] I ran `npm run submit:validate -- --plugin <category>/<name>`.
- [ ] I ran `npm test` and `npm run validate`.
- [ ] The payload contains no credentials, PII, client data, or private material.
- [ ] The generated `.github/plugin/marketplace.json` is included.
- [ ] I understand that passing automation does not publish the plugin; a CODEOWNER must approve and merge the PR.
